questions.question: Four number-pairs have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the number-pair that is different.
questions.solution:
The logic is here is:

**1st number - 2ⁿd number = 118**

Option (1): 727 : 609

Now, follow the logic:

727 – 609 = 118

This option follows the pattern.

Option (2): 373 : 255

Now, follow the logic:

373 - 255 = 118

This option follows the pattern.

**Option (3):** **191 : 177**

**Now, follow the logic:**

**191 – 177 = 14**

**This option do not follow the pattern.**

Option (4): 797 : 679

Now, follow the logic:

797 – 679 = 118

This option follows the pattern.

Hence, pair **“****191 : 177****”** is an odd one.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** The logic followed here is:-

**Sum of digits of first number - Sum of digits of second number = 1**

1) In 727 : 609

Sum of digits of first number = 7 + 2 + 7 = 16

Sum of digits of second number = 6 + 0 + 9 = 15

Sum of digits of first number - sum of digits of second number → 16 - 15 = 1

2) In 373 : 255

Sum of digits of first number = 3 + 7 + 3 = 13

Sum of digits of second number = 2 + 5 + 5 = 12

Sum of digits of first number - sum of digits of second number → 13 - 12 = 1

3) In 191 : 177

Sum of digits of first number = 1 + 9 + 1 = 11

Sum of digits of second number = 1 + 7 + 7 = 15

Here, sum of digits of second number > Sum of digits of first number

Also, Sum of digits of second number - sum of digits of first number → 15 - 11 = 4

4) In 797 : 679

Sum of digits of first number = 7 + 9 + 7 = 23

Sum of digits of second number = 6 + 7 + 9 = 22

Sum of digits of first number - sum of digits of second number → 23 - 22 = 1

As can be seen clearly from the above that 191 : 177 doesn't follow the logic and is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is **"191 : 177".**

• **Symptoms include** Cutaneous Leishmaniasis - Skin ulcers.
 
• **Mucocutaneous Leishmaniasis **- Ulcers in mouth, throat, and nose, Nosebleed, Difficulty in breathing.
 
• **Visceral Leishmaniasis** - Weakness, weight loss, loss of appetite, enlarged spleen, liver, lymph nodes, a decrease in the production of blood cells.

questions.question: Who among the following was one of the leaders of the Santhal rebellion?

__
 
• Santhal Rebellion took place during** Lord Dalhousie (1848-1856) tenure at Rajmahal hills (in Jharkhand) led by Sidhu Manjhi.**
 
• Santhal uprising took place during 1855-56.
 
• **The tyrannical British revenue system, usury practices, and the zamindari system in India made Santhal peoples annoyed, and two Santhal brothers Sidhu and Kanhu Murmu organized 10,000 Santhals and proclaimed a rebellion against the British.**
 
• The Santhals are the largest tribal group in India found in **Jharkhand, WestBengal, and Odisha.**

 
• **Santhal Rebellion:**

 
 
• It was a rebellion against both the British colonial authority and zamindars by the Santhal people.
 
• **Leaders: Sidhu, Kahnu, Chand, and Bhairav.**
 
• **Location**: Jharkhand.
 
• The rebellion was suppressed and largely shadowed by other rebellions.
 
• To quell rebellion British created Santhal Pargana and special laws were

 passed protecting them.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Britishers invited the Santhals to come and settle in** Jharkhand promising land and economic amenities.**
 
• Thus Santhals from different states came to settle in today's Jharkhand.
 
• Later zamindars dominated these areas as they collected taxes and lent money at very high rates which the people could not generally pay and their lands were forcibly taken.
 
• This became the roots of the Santhal rebellion.
 
• In a fierce encounter, **Santhals were defeated **as they were fighting with bows and arrows while Britishers had modern weapons.
 
• Sidhu was caught in** August 1855 **and was hanged on a banyan tree at a place called** Panchkathia.**

questions.question: Points P and Q are on the sides AB and BC respectively of a triangle ABC, right angled at B. If AQ = 11 cm, PC = 8 cm. and AC = 13 cm, then find the length (in cm) of PQ:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1251b4350e51d1697a1dc5f0fa7c5c5cd591854f59cc30ede9ee3adcc6751a7.png] 

In any right angled triange like above 

a = √(b² + c² - d²)

In the question, we have b = 11, c = 8 and d = 13

So, a = √(112 + 82 - 132) 

⇒ a = √16 = 4 cm

**∴ PQ = 4 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

ΔABC is a right-angled triangle at ∠B.

AQ = 11cm

PC = 8cm

AC = 13cm

Concept used: 

Pythagorean theorem states that the sum of the squares on the other two sides of a right-angled triangle is equal to the square on the hypotenuse (the side opposite the right angle)

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d838dfc74f1cb42b530d42e7c7408ed09aba48586f3fa17365d0dac403ff27d4.png] 

Let the length of AB, BC, BQ & PB be T, S, x & y respectively.

Now,

ΔABC, ΔABQ, ΔBPC and ΔPBQ are all right-angled triangles. 

From ΔABC,

⇒ S² + T² = 13² ....(1)

From ΔABQ,

⇒ x² + T2 = 112 ....(2)

From ΔBPC,

⇒ y² + S2 = 82 ....(3)

From ΔPBQ,

⇒ x2 + y2 = PQ2 ....(4)

Adding (2) & (3),

x2 + T2 + y2 + S2 = 112 + 82

⇒ x2 + y2 + (S2 + T2) = 185

⇒ x2 + y2 = 185 - (S2 + T2) 

⇒ x2 + y2 = 185 - 169

⇒ x2 + y2 = 16

⇒ x2 + y2 = 4²

⇒ PQ² = 4² (From 4)

⇒ PQ = 4 (∵ Negative value can't be consider for length)

**∴ The length of PQ is 4cm.**
